set out to forgo slumber for a regional science fair.
went on to take first place.
read press coverage of the attempt and was intrigued.

in monitoring the sleepless boy closely.
and found his short-term memory impaired.
Gardner ended the wearying attempt on 8 January 1964,
Researchers probed the case in a 1965 scholarly paper,
involuntary lapses into sleep lasting a few seconds.

and others have since alleged longer stints awake.

and he himself pinned the blame on the experiment.
